turns.text: One of the biggest mistakes the beginners make is, wait for it, being too polite. But guess what? In real estate, being too nice can cost you a big time. You have to dig deeper and find out what the client's actual situation is, and what problems they are trying to solve with the real estate. When you're walking into the doctor's appointment and there is a nice doctor in a, you know, full gear medical person. How will you yourself determine if he is a professional or someone who is just graduated from the medical school. If a person start to jump up and down, I'm the best doctor and I can absolutely cure you. Will you actually believe him? Or the doctor who is asking you questions, sometimes might be not very polite. He helping you realize that the problem is way bigger than you expect.
